title: Own: loop-terminal checks move out of routes/dashboard.js into lib/run-loop-state.js
description:
Repository: JKershaw/LinearViewer (Harbour). One PR. Heavy lane; a consolidation of stopAt === 'pr' follows it in routes/dashboard.js.

## Why

An Own move (docs/runbooks/improvement-cycles.md; docs/theseus-method-long.md section 5): a decision belongs to the area that would have to change if its rule changed. "Is this run or session over" is decided by the dispatch terminal markers (lib/dispatch-terminal.js), which are Runs & dispatch. It sits in a 3181-line route file, so Agent API files import a Web route, which keeps Agent API <> Web routes a mutual pair. Move it byte for byte, re-export it, and the pair goes. Heavy lane. Measured at 8f39afd8; verify first.

## What is true now

* routes/dashboard.js holds `TERMINAL_AGENT_STATES` (:91-94), `MARKER_TO_AGENT_STATE` (:121-126), `effectiveAgentState` (:225), `isTerminalLoop` (:244), `loopIsTerminal` (:250), `sessionIsTerminal` (:264), `enrichLoop` (:525). Only `isTerminalLoop`, `sessionIsTerminal` and `enrichLoop` are exported; the constants are used only by these functions.
* Importers: server.js:156, routes/task-chat.js:30, routes/flight-companion.js:90, routes/proxy-flight-companion.js:38, routes/proxy-rulings.js:49, and 14 tests.
* seams.mjs at 8f39afd8, with that commit's areas.json: 21 pairs, 410 crossings, 1 group. Agent API <> Web routes is 3 / 5; the 3 Agent->Web crossings are the importers at routes/proxy-flight-companion.js :37-38 and routes/proxy-rulings.js :49.
* routes/flight-companion.js holds `CENSUS_LANE_KEYS` (:113, private) and exported `buildCensusSeedText` (:211-305, doc :130-145). It needs `buildCompanionSnapshot` (lib/flight-companion-gate.js:339) and `renderStaleAttentionLine` (lib/prompts/flight-companion-brief.js:218). The note at :146-155 (and docs/architecture/source-map.md:35) keeps the seed out of the prompt module as "coupled to this route's census read". That went stale when LIN-2631 moved the census read into lib/agent-turn.js (routes/flight-companion.js:55). It is injected into lib/agent-turn.js (:230, :467, :475) by routes/flight-companion.js (:745, :904) and routes/proxy-flight-companion.js (:288).
* The gate is in "Other features"; nothing in Other imports the Agent API. `lib/run-loop-state.js` matches the Runs `run-[^/]*` pattern; `lib/flight-companion-census-seed.js` falls to Other, with the gate: no map edit.

## The move

1. New lib/run-loop-state.js: cut routes/dashboard.js :91-94, :121-126, :209-269 and :513-539 verbatim, comments included. Export all seven names. Only imports: `deriveTerminalStatus`, `deriveCompletedAt`, `isRowClosed` (./dispatch-terminal.js), `findAnchorLoop` (./session-summary.js).
2. routes/dashboard.js imports what it still uses, re-exports the three formerly exported names, and drops imports left unused: `deriveTerminalStatus`, `deriveCompletedAt` and `isRowClosed`. Keep `findWakeEvent`, `isWaitingWakeMarker` and `findAnchorLoop` (used at :289, :805, :1668). server.js and routes/task-chat.js stay untouched.
3. routes/proxy-flight-companion.js :37-38, routes/proxy-rulings.js :49 and routes/flight-companion.js :90 import from the new homes.
4. Move `CENSUS_LANE_KEYS` (with its reason comment, :109-113) and `buildCensusSeedText` (:211-305) verbatim into new lib/flight-companion-census-seed.js, beside the gate. Its only imports: `buildCompanionSnapshot` (./flight-companion-gate.js) and `renderStaleAttentionLine` (./prompts/flight-companion-brief.js). Both routes import it there; routes/flight-companion.js re-exports `buildCensusSeedText` (three tests import it there) and drops its now-unused imports of those two. Move :130-155 to sit directly above `buildCensusSeedText` in the new file. Rewrite only the last two sentences of :146-155 ("That note's own condition has been met..." and "The seed itself deliberately stays here..."). State facts only: the seed lives beside the gate, its counts are the snapshot verbatim, LIN-2631 moved the census read into lib/agent-turn.js. Do not say who owns the seed (see Open questions). :156 onward stays in the route. lib/prompts/flight-companion-brief.js is not touched.

Odd-looking behaviour in the moved code stays byte for byte (class (d)); the PR lists any difference (expected: none).

## Step 1: the move probe

Make the move, run `npm run test:unit` in full, and list every test that pins a file path or source location. Start with: agent-turn-core, flight-companion-turn-route (:1424-1427), dashboard-routes (:4351), lin-3124-pr3-checkpoint-c2, interactive-openrouter-chain-byte-identity, lin-3136-enqueue-census, lin-3383-runner-enqueue-census, proxy-endpoint-inventory-witness, rulings-resolution-contract-drift, lin-3335-one-source-per-kind. Also: proxy-rulings-routes (:737), workspace-accesstoken-linear-egress-census (:192, :215), free-tier-model-clamp-wiring (:38), lin-3384-redaction-census (:135-138), pr-state-store (:200-204). This list is a start: find readers with a read-logging hook, not by search. Record the count and names of tests run before and after.

* A test fails because it reads a source path or text, not behaviour: STOP. Open no PR. Post each pinned test on this ticket with file:line and what it pins. That list becomes a separate Free the seam ticket, which lands first.
* A source-reading test that still passes but now matches only a comment or a re-export counts as a pin: STOP. List (do not edit) the now-false test comment at flight-companion-turn-route.test.js:1411-1414.
* Expected: no existing test changes. Any edit an existing test needs, even an import specifier, is a finding: STOP as above.

## Done when

1. The probe ran; its result is in the PR (or on the ticket if stopped).
2. seams.mjs on the PR's base and head, each with its own areas.json (`git show <sha>:scripts/code-shape/areas.json > file`, third argument): Agent API -> Web routes is 0 and the pair is gone; no pair appears. Modelled: 21 -> 20 pairs, 410 -> 405 crossings; Agent<>Runs 39/9 -> 41/9, LLM<>Other 2/2 -> 2/3, Agent API -> Other 3 -> 4. Explain any difference. If T4 merged first, base 17 pairs/386 crossings, head 16/381 at 7ea6d82a (re-derive at the real base); Agent API <> Web routes still goes.
3. scripts/code-shape/areas.json is unchanged.
4. The replay test passes, and the base-code replay (Tests) shows zero differences; paste its output.
5. The moved text is byte-identical: the PR shows a diff of the cut text against the new files; only the added imports and the one rewritten comment differ. server.js, routes/task-chat.js and lib/chat-tools.js are not in the diff.
6. `npm run test:unit` is green with no existing test file changed; CI `ci-success` is green.

## Tests

`tests/unit/run-loop-state-replay.test.js` (new). Write it and run it green against routes/dashboard.js before the move; expected values are inline literals captured from the old code. After the move, run every row through the BASE code (`git show <base>:` of routes/dashboard.js, routes/flight-companion.js and their imports, written to a temp dir outside the repo) and through the new modules, and `deepStrictEqual` both to the literal. Assert identity too: `dashboard.enrichLoop === runLoopState.enrichLoop` (likewise `isTerminalLoop`, `sessionIsTerminal`, and the route's `buildCensusSeedText`). `enrichLoop(null)` throws TypeError today; pin that with `assert.throws`. At base reach the private names through exports (`enrichLoop(loop).agentState`); after the move also call `effectiveAgentState` and `loopIsTerminal` directly.

* Loops: agentState complete, error, running, waiting; `terminalStatus` undefined with a feedback marker \[done\], \[failed\], \[aborted\] or \[skipped\], undefined with none, null, and each marker set directly; `terminalCompletedAt` undefined, null, set; a bookkeeping-closed row with and without `bookkeeping.at`; `resolvedAt` present and absent; `enrichLoop` returns a copy.
* Sessions: anchor terminal or not, anchorless all terminal or mixed, empty loops, null. Both constants equal their literals.
* Census seed: docs (null, empty attention, rows missing `since`, `lane` or `stage`, truncated, with and without stale-attention fields) to the full expected text.

## Docs

docs/architecture/source-map.md: add lib/run-loop-state.js and lib/flight-companion-census-seed.js; in the flight-companion.js entry (:35) say `buildCensusSeedText` moved, without claiming the owner is settled.

## Files this touches

Edit: routes/dashboard.js, routes/flight-companion.js, routes/proxy-flight-companion.js, routes/proxy-rulings.js, docs/architecture/source-map.md. New: lib/run-loop-state.js, lib/flight-companion-census-seed.js, tests/unit/run-loop-state-replay.test.js. Existing tests: unchanged. Not touched: server.js, routes/task-chat.js, lib/chat-tools.js, the gate, lib/prompts/, areas.json.

## Out of scope

* The follow-on Consolidate: lib/chat-tools.js:1181-1203, the hand-mirrored check `isLoopTerminal` (LIN-1486). Tracked by LIN-1496 (Backlog, "Extract shared terminal-loop-marker predicate"); this move removes its blocker. It equals `loopIsTerminal` only while `terminalStatus` is never undefined, so it needs its own ticket and replay. Do NOT touch it.
* The stops-at-PR copy near routes/dashboard.js:1761; moving `findAnchorLoop`; stale comments naming the routes (lib/task-page-loader.js:38, routes/flight-companion.js:312, lib/render-flight-companion.js:109). List them in the PR, do not edit.

## Open questions

* Owner of the seed. Two plausible homes. LLM & prompts (lib/prompts/): lib/agent-turn.js calls it, its text is what the model reads, and it shares `renderStaleAttentionLine` with the brief. Beside the gate (Other): its counts are `buildCompanionSnapshot` verbatim. The route comment's reason is stale (see above). Default: beside the gate, in lib/flight-companion-census-seed.js, with no prompt module touched. Crossing cost is equal (Other->LLM instead of LLM->Other). Record it in the PR as class (d) for the standing ticket, keep the default, and carry on; do not stop.
* If the seed move cannot be done (a cycle, or a pin only a changed assertion would fix), stop and post a comment: leaving it in the route keeps one Agent->Web crossing, so Done when 2 fails. Default: move it, keeping the route's re-export.

## Operator notes

**Rules for this run**

* No live calls to outside services (GitHub, Linear, OpenRouter, [harbour.cat](<http://harbour.cat>) or any other live host). Tests use the existing fakes.
* No paid model or OpenRouter calls.
* This is one PR. Don't split it into child tickets.
* No parallel forks or background sub-agents; one part at a time.
* Targeted tests while iterating (`node --test tests/unit/<file>.test.js`). Full unit suite (`npm run test:unit`) once before opening the PR. Leave e2e to CI.
* A failing-then-passing test is the witness for any behaviour change.
* Keep every existing ticket reference and every reason comment beside the code it governs; drop one only if its code is gone, and list those in the PR.
* Except `lib/flight-companion-census-seed.js` (waived, see Implementation Plan > Area-map waiver), a new production file (anything outside `tests/` and `docs/`) gets a pattern in `scripts/code-shape/areas.json` for the area that owns it, in the same PR. First match wins there, so check the file lands in that area and not in "Other features": run `node scripts/code-shape/seams.mjs . <commit>` at the base commit and at your final commit, report the area-pair count both times, and give the reason for any new pair. If it cannot run in your checkout (exit 2, `acorn` missing), record it as not run.
* Prompt text (templates, meta-prompt, runner prompt) is size-frozen (`tests/unit/prompt-size-budget.test.js`). If you add prompt text, remove bytes elsewhere or raise the ceiling with the reason recorded beside it (LIN-3633), and say which in the PR.
* Where a choice is still open, keep today's behaviour, write it up as an open question in the PR, and carry on. Never stop to wait for a person. A check that needs a live service or a person is recorded in the PR as not run (what, why, follow-up), not a reason to hold the close.

## Implementation Plan

*Pruned at close-out (20 Oct 2026). Implemented as approved, with no deviations: PR [https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2007](<https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2007>), squash-merged as d10e7398 (branch head 984f8bd7, CI green on it). The plan's steps, probe notes, replay-proof notes, PR-listed stale references, class bounds, surfaces and risks, and the revision changelog are removed here; the full text is preserved in the LIN-3717 task snapshots and the comment trail (plan review f8878269, plan revision 77037971, review d10e7398). The stale references are now tracked by LIN-3723. The census seed's owning area stays an open class (d) question, recorded on LIN-3613.*

### Area-map waiver (resolves review B2)

The Operator-notes rule "a new production file gets an areas.json pattern for its owner" is **waived for** `lib/flight-companion-census-seed.js` **only**. Reason: it sits beside `lib/flight-companion-gate.js`, which is itself in "Other features" (the catch-all owns nothing, docs/theseus-method-long.md:82, :133), and its owning area is an open class (d) question (LLM & prompts vs beside the gate). Assigning it an area now would settle that question by stealth, and the modelled deltas (LLM<>Other 2/2 -> 2/3, Agent API -> Other 3 -> 4) assume the catch-all. `scripts/code-shape/areas.json` stays unchanged. `lib/run-loop-state.js` already matches the Runs `run-[^/]*` pattern, so the rule is met without an edit. Standing ticket for the seed-ownership question: none dedicated exists (searched "standing ticket", "census seed", "class (d)"); the carrier is the **LIN-3613** cycle note (operator's record), and the PR records it there as class (d). Recommendation to carry: beside the gate until a ruling says otherwise.

### Session fit

fits one session. Both moves are mechanical cuts with a shared test and one evidence pass; I cannot name catches that would be easier to see in separate sessions, and the two moves are bound together by Done-when 2.

### Plan-review gate

plan-review due: no
Criteria: (a) no, the session-fit answer is the single-session one; (b) no, no routed-around gap (LIN-1496 is a named out-of-scope follow-on the ticket explicitly forbids touching, not a workaround of this task's cause); (c) no, nothing relaxes a check or guard (the replay test adds pins); (d) no, no credential, merge-rule or dispatch-contract surface (the Runs terminal markers are read, not changed). This is a revision pass after plan-review `f8878269`, so the revised plan can go straight to implementation unless the reviewer wants a second look at the B1/B2 fixes.

comments.body:
### Plan Review Verdict

**Verdict:** Request Changes. The code claims and the seams model reproduce exactly. Two out-of-scope or routed-around items still lack ticket identifiers, and the ticket gives conflicting area-map instructions for the new seed file.

Blocking findings: 2

Grounding: claims re-run at 8f39afd8 and again at origin/main 7ea6d82a. LIN-3716 (#2004) and LIN-3718 (#2005) merged during this review. Neither touches any file this plan edits.

#### Blocking

**B1 (Check 1 + Check 2): the `isLoopTerminal` follow-on needs its ticket identifier, and that ticket already exists: LIN-1496.**
- **The class.** Server-side loop-terminal predicates.
- **How I bounded it.** A grep over lib/, routes/ and server.js for a `{complete, error}` terminal set or an `agentState === 'complete' || … 'error'` check finds exactly two:
  - routes/dashboard.js:94 (this move);
  - lib/chat-tools.js:1198 (`isLoopTerminal`).
  - The only other hits are public/observation.js:483 and :1156. Those are browser code and cannot import lib/.
- **The gap.** The plan does exclude chat-tools correctly, but it only says the work "needs its own ticket". LIN-1486, which it cites, is where the copy came from, not the follow-on.
- **The ticket.** LIN-1496 (Backlog), "Extract shared terminal-loop-marker predicate", was filed for exactly this. It was blocked only on routes/dashboard.js being free to touch, and this move removes that blocker.
- **Fix.** Name LIN-1496 in "Out of scope".

**B2 (Check 2 + Check 5): conflicting area-map instructions for `lib/flight-companion-census-seed.js`, and an unnamed standing ticket.**
- **The conflict.**
  - The Operator notes say a new production file "gets a pattern in areas.json … check the file lands in that area and not in 'Other features'". docs/theseus-method-long.md:82 and :133 say the same: the catch-all owns nothing.
  - Done-when 3 (areas.json unchanged) and "What is true now" place the seed in Other features on purpose.
  - The modelled deltas depend on that placement: LLM<>Other 2/2 → 2/3, and Agent API → Other 3 → 4.
- **What the worker sees.** The distilled brief lists both rules side by side ("must be assigned to the correct area in areas.json" and "Do not touch areas.json"), so the worker gets two instructions that cannot both be followed.
- **What is unnamed.** The ownership question is put off to "the standing ticket", with no identifier.
- **Fix.**
  - Say in the ticket that the Operator-notes area rule is waived for this one file, and why: it sits beside the gate, which is itself in the catch-all, and the owner is an open class (d) question.
  - Name the standing ticket that carries that question.
  - `lib/run-loop-state.js` already meets the rule through the Runs `run-[^/]*` pattern, so nothing changes for it.

#### Verified (no action)

- **Line cites (8f39afd8 and HEAD).**
  - routes/dashboard.js: :91-94, :121-126, :209-269, :513-539, `effectiveAgentState` :225, `isTerminalLoop` :244, `loopIsTerminal` :250, `sessionIsTerminal` :264, `enrichLoop` :525.
  - routes/flight-companion.js: :113, :130-155, :211-305, :745, :904.
  - routes/proxy-flight-companion.js: :37-38, :288.
  - routes/proxy-rulings.js: :49.
  - lib/agent-turn.js: :230, :467, :475.
  - Gate :339, brief :218, source-map :35.
- **Production importers of the moved names.** Exactly server.js:156, task-chat.js:30, flight-companion.js:90, proxy-flight-companion.js:38 and proxy-rulings.js:49. routes/workspace-api.js:57 imports only `settleWithConcurrency`, which is Web → Web.
- **Imports routes/dashboard.js can drop.**
  - `deriveTerminalStatus`, `deriveCompletedAt` and `isRowClosed` appear only inside the moved ranges (:232, :236, :245, :531, :537), so dropping them is safe.
  - `findAnchorLoop` stays (:289, :805, :1668).
  - Note that dashboard.js still calls `loopIsTerminal` at :2891, so it must import it back. "Imports what it still uses" covers this.
- **Imports routes/flight-companion.js can drop.** `buildCompanionSnapshot` (:231) and `renderStaleAttentionLine` (:288) are used only inside the seed. `DEFAULT_SWEEP_LIVENESS_HORIZON_MS` stays on the gate import line.
- **No import cycle.** The gate imports only `node:crypto` and `./utils/time.js`, and the brief has no imports.
- **The seed note is stale, as the plan says.** The turn's census read is at lib/agent-turn.js:273-275 and :318-320.
- **Seams baseline at 8f39afd8 (its own map).** 21 pairs, 410 crossings, 1 group. Agent<>Web is 3/5, and the 3 Agent → Web crossings are exactly the 3 importers named.
- **Seams after a simulated move** (import edges only, in a throwaway worktree, base map):
  - 21 → 20 pairs, 410 → 405 crossings, 1 → 1 group.
  - Agent<>Runs 39/9 → 41/9, LLM<>Other 2/2 → 2/3, Agent → Other 3 → 4.
  - Agent<>Web is gone and no pair appears. This matches the model exactly.
- **Check 3 (history).**
  - The moved ranges were last touched by afad1bbb (LIN-3364).
  - The constraints from LIN-622, LIN-632, LIN-2444, LIN-2773, LIN-2661 and LIN-2618 live in comments that move byte for byte.

- **Check 5 (relaxation guard).** The move loosens no check. `enrichLoop(null)` throwing TypeError is pinned.
- **Check 6.** No prerequisite refactor is split out. The conditional "Free the seam" ticket names its cause.

#### Non-blocking (fold in while fixing B1/B2)

1. **The base has moved (Re-ground).** At 7ea6d82a, with that commit's own map, the base is 17 pairs / 386 crossings and the simulated head is 16 / 381. Agent<>Runs goes 40/9 → 42/9, because LIN-3718 added one Agent → Runs crossing. The plan's "if T4 merged" line says 17/385 → 16/380, which is one crossing off. Update it, or the "explain any difference" step will fire on a known cause.
2. **Step 4's cut range should include the reason comment.** `CENSUS_LANE_KEYS`'s reason comment is :109-112, directly above :113. Cite :109-113 so the comment travels with the constant (the Operator-notes rule) and Done-when 5 diffs the right range.

   - Say it is a one-off run outside the suite, following the LIN-3604 setup: `git archive` plus a `node_modules` symlink (experiments/lin-3604-entrance-replay/README.md). The committed test checks against the inline literals and the identity asserts.

Add it to the plan's list of stale route-naming comments in the PR. Also list docs/papers/harbour/coherence-as-it-grows-scripts/decision-exposure.py:82, which looks for `function isTerminalLoop\(` in routes/dashboard.js. It is not a test.
6. **Check 4 (session fit).** The plan makes no session-fit claim beyond "One PR. Heavy lane." The two moves are tied together by Done-when 2: the pair only goes if both Agent → Web importers move. So one session is consistent, and there is no contradiction to flag.

**Hand-off:** back to `plan` to fix B1 and B2 (fold in non-blocking items 1–5). This is not an implementation Approve.

### Plan revision (after Plan Review Verdict f8878269)

Description now carries one `## Implementation Plan` (appended; the ticket body is otherwise unchanged except three surgical edits).

- **B1**: LIN-1496 named as the tracker for the `isLoopTerminal` follow-on (Out of scope + Strategy framing).

  - The seed file imports only `buildCompanionSnapshot` and `renderStaleAttentionLine`.
  - dashboard.js has no remaining references to the dropped imports or the two constants. `effectiveAgentState` appears in it only in comments (:265, :274).
  - flight-companion.js no longer references `buildCompanionSnapshot`, `renderStaleAttentionLine` or `CENSUS_LANE_KEYS`.
- **Regression check.** In `git log -8` over the four routes, the only commit that touched the dashboard import line is ee9fcba9 (LIN-3602, `isWaitingWakeMarker`). That import is kept intact. Nothing reverted is re-applied.
- **Replay on the base code (the "Tests" requirement).** I re-ran it myself rather than citing the PR's md5s.
  - Commit 869803ad (base code plus the test, importing the old route functions): 54/54 pass.
  - Head 984f8bd7 (the new lib modules): 58/58 pass.
  - Between the two commits the literal rows are untouched. Only call sites and the identity, private-helper and constant tests changed.
  - So the same literals hold on both the old and the new code.
- **Mutation check of the replay test.** I made each mutation, ran the test, and reverted it. All 8 went red:
  - MARKER_TO_AGENT_STATE `skipped` → error: 4 fail
  - `effectiveAgentState` with the `isRowClosed` branch removed: 3 fail
  - `terminalStatus !== undefined` check removed: 10 fail
  - `isTerminalLoop` without `isRowClosed`: 4 fail
  - seed `since` fallback changed: 3 fail
  - seed truncated suffix removed: 2 fail
  - dashboard re-export replaced with a wrapper: 1 fail (identity)
  - route seed re-export replaced with a wrapper: 1 fail (identity)
- **Probe STOP (b): does any test still pass only because it matches a comment or a re-export?** The implementer left this open ("did not read each of the ~45 reading tests"), so I bounded it by mutation rather than by reading:
  - **Comments.** I stripped every comment line in the four route files that names a moved symbol, run-loop-state, census-seed or LIN-3717 (13 lines) and ran the full `npm run test:unit`: 18916/18916 pass. No test depends on that comment text.
  - **Re-exports.** I deleted both re-export statements and ran the full suite again: 50 fail.
    - 23 test files fail at import with `does not provide an export named`, directly or through server.js/task-chat.js.
    - The rest are replay-test rows that call through the route and its identity assert.
    - No failure is an assertion over source text, so no test pins the re-export as text.
  - `flight-companion-turn-route.test.js:1427` `/buildCensusSeedText,/` matches the live call sites at routes/flight-companion.js :620 and :779, not the re-export. :1415 reads lib/agent-turn.js, which is untouched.
  - STOP (b) is clear.
- **Seams.** I ran `seams.mjs` on each commit with its own areas.json; the two files are byte-identical.
  - Base 7ea6d82a: 17 pairs, 386 crossings, 1 group.
  - Head: 16 pairs, 381 crossings, 1 group.
  - Agent API <> Web routes (3/5) is gone.
  - Agent API <> Runs: 40/9 → 42/9. LLM & prompts <> Other: 2/2 → 2/3.
  - No new pair. This matches the plan-review model exactly.
- **Docs.** source-map.md adds both lib entries. The flight-companion.js entry says the seed moved and that "which area owns the seed is an open question, not a settled one".
- **Stale references.** The PR body lists all the plan's stale/false references, without editing them, plus one extra comment inside the moved function. No ticket reference was dropped.

### Isolated, or one of a class?
- **Class: production imports from Agent API files into a Web route.** After the move it is empty: seams shows Agent API -> Web routes = 0. Handled.
- **Class: server-side loop-terminal predicates.** The remaining instance is `isLoopTerminal` in lib/chat-tools.js. It is **outside** this ticket: the ticket explicitly excludes it, and LIN-1496 (Backlog) already exists for it. This move removes its blocker. No new ticket is needed.
- **Sibling LIN-3722 (stops-at-PR rule in dashboard.js).** **Outside**: its own ticket already exists.
- Otherwise the change is isolated.

### Test level
The move is a pure-function relocation behind identity re-exports. Unit replay plus identity tests are the right level. Route-level behaviour through server.js and task-chat.js is covered by the existing route tests: 23 files depend on the re-export, as the mutation above showed. E2E is green.

### What CI Did Not Prove
- **Inside** (plan B2 resolution: the area-map waiver depends on a named carrier for the seed-ownership question). The plan and the PR both say the class (d) question is "carried on the LIN-3613 cycle note", but LIN-3613 has no comment that mentions LIN-3717, the census seed or class (d). I checked its description and all 10 comments.
  - **Settle before the merge:** close-out posts one comment on LIN-3613 recording the class (d) item. It should give the two candidate homes (LLM & prompts via lib/prompts/, or beside the gate in Other features) and the default kept (beside the gate in lib/flight-companion-census-seed.js, no areas.json entry, recommended until a ruling says otherwise), and link PR #2007.
  - Discharged when that comment exists on LIN-3613.
- **Inside**: does any test pass only on a comment or re-export (probe STOP b)? CI cannot see this. **Discharged** by the comment-strip and re-export-strip full-suite mutations above.
- **Inside**: is the move behaviour-identical to the base code? The committed test only checks the literals. **Discharged** by my re-run: the pre-move commit (54/54) and the head (58/58) pass against the same literals.
- **Inside**: Done-when 2 and 3 (seams, areas.json unchanged). These are not in CI. **Discharged** by my seams re-run above.
- **Outside**: stale comments and docs that still name the routes are listed in the PR and deliberately not edited (ticket Out of scope). Those are tests/unit/flight-companion-turn-route.test.js:1411-1414, lib/task-page-loader.js:38, routes/flight-companion.js:187, lib/render-flight-companion.js:109, "which this route must not add" and "this route's own filtered attention" in lib/flight-companion-census-seed.js, and docs/papers/harbour/coherence-as-it-grows-scripts/decision-exposure.py:82.
  - **Settle:** close-out files one follow-up to correct them, after checking it does not already exist. A comment-only fix; existing tests may be edited there.
- **Outside**: LIN-1496's blocker (routes/dashboard.js not free to touch) is now removed. Close-out may comment that on LIN-1496 so it can be picked up. This is not a condition on the merge.

### Verdict
Approve — conditional on close-out discharging the ledger

The move is complete and byte-identical, and the evidence holds up on independent re-runs: the base replay, 8/8 mutations red, the probe bounded by two full-suite mutations, and seams exact. The only open item is the missing LIN-3613 class (d) note, which close-out posts before merging.

## Close-out — LIN-3717

**Merged:** PR https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2007, squash-merged as `d10e7398`, pinned with `--match-head-commit 984f8bd7` (the exact head CI and review covered). The review verdict was Approve, conditional on one ledger item (d10487e7).

**Changes I made to the code:** none. The review asked for no code fixes, so the merged tree is exactly the reviewed head.

**CI:** CI exists. On head 984f8bd7 every check was SUCCESS: CI success, Unit tests, E2E shards 1-4, Secret scan. Main moved from 7ea6d82a to 71a42131 (LIN-3714, KPI files) before the merge; the PR stayed MERGEABLE/CLEAN, and only `docs/architecture/source-map.md` was touched by both, with no conflict. After the merge, the `Tests` run on main at d10e7398 completed with success.

**Ledger**
- *Inside, LIN-3613 class (d) note:* posted on LIN-3613 before the merge (comment 8c3a76b1), with both candidate homes, the default kept (beside the gate, no areas.json entry) and the PR link. Discharged.
- *Inside, probe STOP (b), behaviour identity, seams / areas.json:* discharged by the reviewer's independent re-runs (comment-strip and re-export-strip full-suite mutations, 54/54 on the pre-move commit and 58/58 on head, 8/8 mutations red, seams 17/386 -> 16/381). Green CI is not the evidence for these. I did not repeat them.
- *Post-merge check I ran:* in a fresh clone at `d10e7398`, `lib/run-loop-state.js` and `lib/flight-companion-census-seed.js` exist and `node --test tests/unit/run-loop-state-replay.test.js` passes 58/58.

- *Outside, LIN-1496:* commented that its blocker is removed, and linked it as related. It was not touched.

**Deploy:** it landed. The live footer on harbour.cat moved from 7ea6d82a to 71a42131 and then to `d10e7398`. On what landed, `/` and `/kpis` return 200. `GET /api/proxy/rulings` (which goes through the repointed `routes/proxy-rulings.js` import) returns 200. No post-deploy step was asked for in the ticket. The dashboard route itself is behind a login I do not have, so I did not exercise `enrichLoop` live; that path is covered by the 23 route test files that depend on the re-export. Who could run it: the operator, by opening a loop page. No monitor is attached.

**Archive and prune:** `GET /issues/LIN-3717/brief?noRefresh=1` was called, and `/snapshots` shows a snapshot (12:00:52Z) whose description is identical to the pre-prune one. I then pruned the Implementation Plan section down to a stub: implemented as approved with no deviations, PR link, history preserved in the snapshots and the comments.
